item.title: The evolution of population spatialisation in the era of big data and artificial intelligence: a systematic review
item.dc:title: The evolution of population spatialisation in the era of big data and artificial intelligence: a systematic review
item.dc:creator: Jiacheng Chen Xuying Bai Kai Cao a Key Laboratory of Geographic Information Science (Ministry of Education), School of Geographic Sciences, East China Normal University, Shanghai, Chinab State Key Laboratory of Estuarine and Coastal Research, East China Normal University, Shanghai, ChinaJiacheng Chen is a master’s student at East China Normal University. His research interests include population spatialisation and population projection. Xuying Bai is a Ph.D. student at East China Normal University. Her research interests include Geographic Information Science and spatial justice in population ageing. Kai Cao is a Professor and Zijiang Outstanding Young Scholar in the School of Geographic Sciences at East China Normal University (ECNU), Shanghai, China. His research interests primarily focus on Geographic Information Science and its applications, particularly Spatial Optimisation, Spatial Big Data Analytics, and Spatially Integrated Social Sciences (e.g., ageing and health).
